title: FiloSkin
text: “Oh, save Sakura for last. Now, since I think you’ll like this, open that compact, hold your hand over it, and shout, ‘Melfilo Metamorph Wing!’”
“I don’t really know what that means, but okay! Melfilo Metamorph Wing!”

Fleon-chan shouts just as she’s told. Then, accompanied by a dazzling light, the light gathers around Fleon-chan, and her outfit begins to change. Oh… Fleon-chan, whose hairstyle used to look just like Filo-tan’s, now has fluffy, voluminous twin tails, and her outfit has transformed into a mini-dress. It’s an outfit with plenty of ribbons. With a sharp “snap,” Fleon-chan struck a pose.
“This is… amazing! We’ve got to show this to everyone else, too. What should we call Fleon? Let’s tentatively go with ‘Magical Fleon’!”

Fleon-chan’s eyes, which had been a bit dazed, are now glowing even more brightly with a fiery light! She looked a little disappointed that Itsuki wouldn’t play with her, but right now, Fleon-chan is full of life!
“Is this the ‘morning transformation heroine’ route?”
In the distance, Itsuki is watching Fleon-chan’s transformation and analyzing it. Come to think of it, the idea for Melfilo originally came from Ren and Itsuki, didn’t it?
“Ms. Gaelion sure knows how to put on a show. If this makes Fleon-san’s attention drift away from me, that’d be absolutely perfect.”
Itsuki… if you’d just spend time with Fleon-chan, she’d enjoy being Philoreal Mask No. 2 without you having to go through all this trouble!
Big Sister, Finacée, and Assistant are all staring blankly at Fleon-chan, who has just finished her transformation.
“Rafu.”
The Raph-species creature held by Big Sister is chirping at the sight.
“This is the transformation compact of Melfilo, the legendary warrior who appears in various worlds. It’s a power bestowed upon chosen girls—”
That’s news to me. Above all, Melfilo is something you started doing after reuniting with Fleon-chan.
“What’s the concept here? I can actually guess the origin of the name ‘Melfilo,’ though.”
“Naofumi-chan, you look like you’re having so much fun!”
“What’s all the commotion about?”
Just then, the Panda was drawn by the light from Fleon-chan’s transformation scene and came over.
“You’re dressed in quite a strange outfit. Did you buy one of Zeltoble’s weird products or something?”
“Are there any? Like this?”
“This kind of novelty item is practically a local specialty over there.”
“That’s just like you, Panda. You really know your stuff when it comes to this sort of thing.”
Apparently, he’s actually quite fond of cute things.
“I wish you wouldn’t just assume things like that!”
“Oh my? Are you joining in too, Sasa-chan?”
“Don’t drag me into this! Ugh… So, what’s going on here?”
“It looks like Gaelion-chan made these and was handing them out.”

“Oh my, it looks like she’s been making and handing out some pretty elaborate homemade items. Those are the ones the folks over there are holding, right? At first glance, they look quite intricate. Don’t you think they’d be worth some money?”
“I have no intention of selling the real ones. Of course, I’m limiting who can use them.”
The Rival said firmly. She looks like she knows her place, but that’s not the case at all.
“Next up is Rafu.”
“Eh…”
Big Sister’s face turned pale. Just by her expression, she’s clearly saying she doesn’t want to.
“Raph-species!”

The Raph-species quickly opened the compact and called out. Then the compact glowed, enveloping Big Sister and the Raph-species, and their outfits changed. They’re clearly going for an outfit with lots of ribbons. In Big Sister’s case, a large brown-and-black striped ribbon adorns her waist. Perhaps influenced by the Raph-species’ presence, she’s also wearing a mini top hat and a bow tie.
“Raph-species!”
With a thud, the Raph-species lands on the Big Sister’s shoulder and strikes a pose. As always, he’s full of energy.
“Wonderful! That was Raphtalia, wasn’t it? How about… ‘Melfilo Illusion’ for you?”
The Big Sister’s older sister clapped her hands enthusiastically.
“Raphtalia-chan, you’re so cute!”
“Uh, well…”
Big Sister seems at a loss for words as she turns to face Father and her older sister.
“Raff!”
The Raph-species is totally into it, striking a pose.
“That sounds great!”
“Ugh…”
“Raphtalia-chan hasn’t said a word. Isn’t that just her opinion?”
“Rafu!”
“Yeah… you, though. Raphtalia-chan’s wishes matter too, you know?”
“Rafu!”
In response to Father’s reminder, the Raph-species looked at Big Sister and chirped as if to say, “Leave it to me.”
“Well, that’s a bit of a problem.”
“Rafu-rafu.”
“Now, now,” the Raph-species said, taking Big Sister’s hand.
“Well, that armor does boost your combat power, you know. You never know what might happen in this world, so keep it—it’ll serve as a good-luck charm in an emergency.”
“Uh…”
And just like that, Big Sister’s transformation was complete.
“What was that evil light just now?!”
“Ugh! They’re swarming toward the light!”
Just then, Black Thunder showed up. At that, Ren turned his back as if to flee and ran off.
“Wasn’t there a Dark Holy Hero here just now?”
“Um…”
“If you’re asking about Ren-san, he ran off that way.”
With that, Itsuki pointed in the opposite direction, so I pointed in the direction Ren had fled. Then, Fleon gave a thumbs-up before pointing in the direction I’d indicated.
“I’ll thank you, The Love Hunter <TIME Drive>!　No matter how much you resist, the darkness is waiting for you to awaken, Hahahahahaha!”
Black Thunder ran off in the direction Ren had fled.
“Ren’s got it rough, doesn’t he… Though I don’t feel sorry for him since he agreed to the Raph-species production.”
My father muttered this, his gaze fixed on the distance where Ren and Black Thunder had disappeared.
“Who should we go after next?”
The lively Fleon-chan turned toward the assistant, her Finacée, and Sakura-chan, who had been left behind. The assistant and her Finacée wore expressions that were hard to describe.
“Gaelion…”
“My sister’s is a special edition!”
It seemed like her Rival was giving a completely off-the-mark response to the assistant’s confusion.
“Special…?”
“Hmm… w-where am I? What on earth is this!?”
“The compact has woken up! I made Big Sis’s compact the only one with a mind of its own!”
“A thing imbued with a will? You’ve made something strange again, haven’t you?”
“It exists. That sort of thing.”
“I suppose it’s not impossible.”
Ignoring Panda’s explanation, the Assistant is staring intently at the compact.
“When Big Sis transforms, she becomes Saint Windy! And this compact’s name is Jack!”
“That’s a hero’s name! Wonderful!”
“D-don’t just go naming me on your own!”
“Gaelion remembers that you introduced yourself that way. Now, go ahead and fulfill your duty to protect your big sister to the fullest!”
“What!? Guh…”
Jack let out a frustrated groan. Then, the Assistant was dragged into it and transformed as well. According to my Father, he said it would work just as well as a dress-up costume.
“Next up is Princess Melty—but since I’m one half of the original Melfilo, I’ll skip my part!”
“I wonder if I’m supposed to be happy about being skipped… even though I’m being forced to transform.”
“Is Sakura last?”
Sakura-chan, who had been daydreaming, raises her hand and asks.
“That’s right. So it’s Sakura’s turn! I’ve got a special surprise in store, so let’s give it a try! It’s the result of years of research!”
“Sakura-chan, I’ve got a bad feeling about this. Maybe you shouldn’t do it?”
“Yeah. Gaelion, you really need to tone down the pranks a bit, don’t you?”
“Is that so? I thought it was a great way to solve Fleon and the Bow Hero’s problems.”
“Ah… well, if I let them play with Melty and the others, it might mean they’d bother Itsuki less. I’d be happy if everyone just played nicely together, though.”
I get the feeling there’s something fishy going on here.
“Sakura-chan, I have a bad feeling about this, so you should probably stop. What my Rival does is never anything good, you know.”
“Coming from you, that doesn’t carry much weight!”
Itsuki is protesting in the distance, but I couldn’t care less. Fleon-chan is more important than Itsuki’s troubles. My top priorities are Filo-tan, my Father, and Filolial-sama, after all.
“Well, don’t say that. Forced transformation compact activation!”

As my Rival said that, Sakura-chan’s compact glowed brightly and enveloped her. A dazzling light swirled around Sakura-chan; her slightly unruly hair became sleek and straight, turning blonde, her wings turned white, and she wore a blue ribbon on a white background… Oooooooooooh!?
When the light faded, what appeared was—none other than Filo-tan!
“Hmm? What’s this?”
“Whoa… Sakura-chan has turned into the spitting image of that girl Filo that Motoyasu-kun always draws!?”

“This is the original Melfilo Filo, created after a lot of research! It’s a Sakura-exclusive Filo skin! I did this so that even in the loop where Sakura is, the Spear Hero would be a bit easier on the eyes!”
“Fii-rooooooooooooooo――――”
“Nyaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa!?”
The next thing I knew, my Father had me in a bear hug from behind and had blindfolded me. It was exactly the same situation as when I encountered the great Filolial-sama.
“W-what on earth is going on here!?”
“Motoyasu-kun, don’t you remember? You suddenly jumped at Sakura-chan—who had just transformed—just like the third generation of a certain phantom thief!”
“That was a magnificent jump. There’s no other way to describe that leap.”
“Motoyasu-san, unwanted hugs are a no-no! Fleon absolutely won’t allow that!”
Fleon-chan scolded me—I guess she’s angry.
“The Spear Hero really is a beast, isn’t he?”
That panda is so noisy! You’re the beast here.
“But Filo-tan descended right before my very eyes!”
Rival! You usually don’t do anything worthwhile, but I’ll give you credit for doing a good job this time!
“If even Gaelion-chan understands that, you shouldn’t be doing something like this!”
“This is definitely unexpected. I thought you’d nitpick about the smell or something, but the Spear Hero went on a rampage way more than I expected.”
What’s going on? For some reason, I feel like I’m getting scolded and my reputation is taking a hit.
“Ugh…”
“Sakura-chan, let’s just cancel your transformation for now, okay? Otherwise, the Spear Hero is definitely going to go on another rampage.”
“Yeah. Sakura, I don’t need this! Oh, it’s coming back. Yaaah!”
“Ah, wait a sec. It’s got a Magic anti-loss spell on it, so even if you throw it away, it’ll come right back to you. Plus, you haven’t even undone the transformation yet!”
“Whoa… Even my Filolial form has taken on the color scheme of that girl, Filo.”

I heard a commotion, and Sakura-chan’s voice faded into the distance. Eventually, the blindfold was removed, and there was the usual Sakura-chan, using her Father and Finacée as human shields while looking at me with teary eyes.
“Spear Hero, you really need to learn to hold back a little. Seriously… the calibration is way too strict.”
“Shouldn’t you have just chosen not to do it from the start?”
“Naofumi asked me to get along with the Spear Hero, so Gaelion has no choice but to do this.”
“It certainly seems like the best possible way to curry favor with Motoyasu-san.”
Guh… That rival of mine—what on earth has he created? It’s a brilliant invention that turns Sakura-chan into Filo-tan.
“While I’m extremely dissatisfied, I’ll honestly praise and laud that technical prowess.”
“Yay! It gives me goosebumps! Naofumi! Mel-chan!”
Sakura-chan is licking away as Filo-tan.
“This won’t do. The Spear Hero is going to end up being completely hated by Sakura.”
“Rival! Keep up the research! Sakura-chan is the ultimate proof of Filo-tan!”
“Yay!”
Oh… Sakura-chan is making the same sound as Filo-tan. How wonderful!
“Gaelion, Sakura-chan doesn’t like this.”
The Assistant cautioned the rival.
“That’s right, that’s right!”
Jack too, you know.
“Motoyasu-kun, you need to learn a little more patience. Or rather, in a loop where that girl Filo exists, Motoyasu-kun might always be like this…”
“That’s entirely possible. He’s a total pervert, isn’t he?”
“Motoyasu-san! That’s no good!”
“That’s right! Dragon! Put that skin on me!”
“Yuki-chan, what are you saying in the midst of all this confusion?”
“I’m sorry, but no one but Sakura can be Filo. In fact, it’d be safer for Rafu to just show her a hallucination.”
“Ugh… You’re such a useless dragon!”

Some time passed after that, and Sakura-chan went out somewhere with her Finacée. It’s a real shame. When my father returned to his post, he ended up taking care of Jack from his Assistant as she was leaving.
“It seems dangerous to let Motoyasu meet Filo. It really makes you realize how hard Naofumi had it in the first world and in Filo’s world.”
“Well, yeah. Thinking about Motoyasu’s happiness, I wanted him to meet Filo, but she’s a real handful—at least in this situation…”
“Filo has been skillfully avoiding any face-to-face encounters with the Spear Hero, and the Spear Hero himself is a bit too subdued because his desire isn’t strong enough.”
“Ah, so the fact that she isn’t in this loop makes things worse than usual, I see.”
“Either way, she’s a nuisance…”
“Rafu.”
Ugh… My reputation is taking a hit because of my Rival’s scheming. I suppose I should set the record straight here.
“But Father, we’ve got Filo-tan here!?”
“Spear Hero, no matter how much you like Filo, a guy who just throws himself at her without asking is going to get hated.”
“True.”
“That’s for sure.”
Filo-tan doesn’t hate me!
“Gaelion used to go wild, licking the water from Naofumi’s bath and all that, but if you do something like that, it’s only natural to be disliked.”
My Father is staring at my Rival with a look of utter shock, but as if to say, “Well then,” my Rival pulls out another Compact. Just how many of these have you made?!
